stories.headline: Pakistan's LPG prices rise sharply after Iran-border supply disruptions
stories.summary: Reuters reported on 3 November that two closed Iran border crossings disrupted LPG supply to Pakistan; traders said a 12-kg cylinder rose 56% to Rs7,000.
stories.what_happened: The closures on 17 October interrupted LPG trade. The Pakistan LPG Association reported that about 7,000 tonnes had previously arrived daily from Iran.
stories.background: Imported fuel interruptions can impose disproportionate costs on rickshaw drivers and low-income households.

stories.headline: Germany awards 5.16 GW of mainly gas-fired backup power contracts
stories.summary: Germany awarded contracts valued at around €12 billion for 5.16 GW of dispatchable electricity capacity, Reuters reported on 3 November.
stories.what_happened: LEAG secured around 3 GW and RWE approximately 2.12 GW. Subsidised plants are intended to supply power when renewable generation is insufficient.
stories.background: The tender illustrates the costs and reliability challenges of replacing coal with intermittent renewables and backup generation.
